title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Priya Patel
body:
Context: This PR hardens RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS key region residency (region-pinning) and expands audit logging for all KMS-related policy decisions. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require deterministic data residency guarantees and complete audit trails for key access. This change closes several gaps where requests could be routed to keys in an unintended region and where audit logs lacked sufficient context for post-incident analysis.

What this PR does (summary): - Enforce region pinning at policy evaluation time for RBAC v2 (opt-in via config flag for initial rollout). - Add per-evaluation audit entries including policy_id, decision_reason, requested_key_arn, evaluated_region, and matched_rules. - Introduce a KMS residency helper that normalizes region metadata and provides deterministic residency checks for multi-region keys. - Add migration SQL to backfill existing key metadata where available and mark keys with residency hints. - Tighten unit and integration tests and CI security checks.

Files/areas changed (high level): - rbac/v2/policy_enforcer.go: policy enforcement flow changes and residency checks. - rbac/v2/audit/logger.go: structured audit entry schema + helpers. - services/kms/kms_policy.go: KMS residency helpers and canonicalization. - config/security.yaml: new flags: rbac_v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning (bool), rbac_v2.kms_residency_mode (audit|enforce). - migrations/20260210_kms_region_pin.sql: backfill script for key residency hints. - docs/rbac-v2-kms-region-pinning.md: operational guidance and rollout plan. - test/integration/rbac_kms_region_test.go: new integration suite exercising cross-region cases. - ci/security_checks.yaml: added audit log linter and policy tests.

Commits (high level): - 9f3a2b1: initial enforcement scaffolding and config flag. - ab4c7d2: add residency normalization utilities. - 3c9d8ea: structured audit entries and serializers. - f1e2d3c: add migration SQL and DB migration runner hook. - b7a6c5d: integration tests and CI pipeline updates.

Rollout plan / migration: 1) Merge behind feature flag rbac_v2.kms_residency_mode=audit (default). 2) Run migrations in staging to backfill residency hints. 3) Observe audit logs for false positives for 48-72h. 4) Flip to enforce mode on a canary org with monitoring for auth failures. 5) Gradually expand enforcement by org and region, with automatic fallback configured to allow legacy keys if an org requests rollout freeze.

Testing performed: - Unit tests covering enforcement decision branches and residency normalization (new table of edge cases). - Integration tests simulating cross-region key requests, multi-tenant scenarios, and fallback behavior. - E2E smoke on staging with canary org. - CI: full test matrix and security linters all passing.

Monitoring and observability: - New metrics: rbac.kms_region_pin.denied_total, rbac.kms_region_pin.allowed_total, rbac.kms_audit_log.entries_emitted. - Dashboards added to Redwood Console (docs includes dashboard panels). - Alerting: SLO alert if denied rate spikes > 0.5% for known-good workloads during rollout.

Backout plan: Flip rbac_v2.kms_residency_mode back to audit or disable enforcement flag. Migration is additive; backfill data does not change key material.

Security review notes: Reviewed with Security (SEC-402) and Privacy. No secrets introduced. KMS helpers do not cache plaintext keys.

Release notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 and expand audit logging for KMS access events. Default mode is audit-only; enforcement is opt-in per config and via rollout.

References: ENG-2147, SEC-402, SUP-8891.

CI: all checks passed (unit/integration/security lint).

Merge: Squash merged by Marina Ivanov on 2026-02-22.
commits_summary: initial scaffolding for enforcement; residency normalization utilities; structured audit entries; migration SQL and runner; integration tests and CI updates
review_comments: Ethan Moore (review): Please add a unit test for region-ambiguity where key ARN omits explicit region. Also prefer explicit error codes in audit payload.
Author (Priya): Added ambiguity unit test and extended audit schema with error_code and decision_reason fields (see audit/logger.go).
Sofia Alvarez (review): Suggest making the config default to audit-only to avoid customer disruption during rollout.
Author (Priya): Default is audit-only; clarified in config/security.yaml and docs. Added rollout guidance to docs.
Liam Chen (approval): Verified integration tests and manual staging smoke. Approving once CI green.
testing_summary: Unit + integration + staging smoke. Migration backfill tested on a snapshot of staging metadata. CI security linters and audit log schema checks passed.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 and expand audit logging for KMS access events. Default is audit-only; enforcement is gated and rolled out incrementally.
impact: This strengthens policy enforcement and auditability for KMS access. Default behavior is non-breaking (audit mode). Enforcement can cause auth denials when enabled for orgs with misconfigured keys.
notes_for_ops: Run migration on maintenance window. Enable canary via org toggle in Redwood Console and monitor rbac.kms_region_pin.denied_total. Backout by switching to audit mode.
advisories: Customers with multi-region key setups should review key ARNs and residency hints before enforcement. Support team notified (SUP-8891).
